text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Vodka teaching a junior 
some tips on how to start at the gate.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
I-It just isn't going well at all... I 
can't seem to get the feel for it...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You're overthinking it, man! 
Rocketing out of the gate is a piece of 
cake!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You just glare down the gate— go 
*hnnngh*... and then *KABOOM*! That's it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text: *Hnnngh*...? *KABOOM*...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, you don't get it, huh. Then, uhh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*Creak, creak*~... and then blow it away 
way out there, *WHAM*!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
...W-Way out there??? Umm, so that 
means...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(...D-Dammit~. I'm totally not getting 
through!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(Man. At times like this... Gim-senpai 
would give such cool advice using badass 
words~!)
—"Hmph... O lost little lamb..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wh-Where am I—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gim-senpai!?

text_block_list.name: Inner Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. —"*Hnnngh*... and then *KABOOM*"! A 
resonance truly befitting of you.

text_block_list.name: Inner Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Is that not preaching to store power 
within the legs, and release it all 
against the transient barricade?

text_block_list.name: Inner Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The reason my soul resonates so specially 
with yours, and why your heart reaches 
me... is because our souls "attune" our 
words to one another.

text_block_list.name: Inner Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What kind of run do you desire for her? 
Attune your words for this wandering 
junior! Weave your words with your little 
grey cells!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text: —san? V-Vodka-sa~n...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Gah!! S-Sorry! I totally spaced out 
there!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: (Tuning my words... uhhh)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(The *hnnngh*... is like gathering power? 
And the *kaboom*... means... I want her to 
swing her legs like kicking out!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! Store up your power real good, 
and then launch out like you're gonna kick 
the gate down!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text: K-Kick it down... you say!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If you slam into the gate, you can 
just smash it! If you think of it like 
that, it ain't scary at all, right?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
...I-I see! That makes sense! Somehow, I 
feel like I can totally do it now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Vodka took her time conveying 
the right sensation... and her junior's 
start improved beyond recognition.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, with this much momentum... Thank you 
so much, Vodka-san!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Don't sweat it! You and I are 
really starting to resonate, aren't we!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka and her junior continued their 
special training... and she seemed to have 
completely mastered the rocket start!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, I can't believe I did that... Thank 
you, Vodka-san!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haha, don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They continued training after that, and 
she seemed to have completely overcome her 
starting troubles.
